traceDiagram.title: Pokemon API requests flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how FastAPI runs `require_api_key()` before every handler of `/api/v1/pokemon` and `/api/v1/pokemon/{pokemon_id}`. It also shows what happens when a request reaches each method of the two paths, and how the Pokemon reach the party in `pokedex.pokemon.store` through `save_pokemon()`, `find_pokemon()` and `remove_pokemon()`.

traceNodes.label: Catches a Pokemon or lists the party of a trainer
traceNodes.description: When a client sends `POST` or `GET` to `/api/v1/pokemon`, FastAPI matches the path below [the `/pokemon` prefix of the router](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L7), which [`main.py` includes under `/api/v1`](code:src/pokedex/main.py#L9). FastAPI then runs [`require_api_key()` from the dependencies of the router](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L7) and calls the handler of the method.

children.label: Saves a new Pokemon to the party of the trainer
children.description: When a client sends `POST /api/v1/pokemon`, FastAPI [parses the body into `PokemonDraft`](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L11) and [calls `current_trainer()` for the `CurrentTrainer` parameter](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/dependencies.py#L22). FastAPI then calls this handler and [answers with a 201](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L10).

blockLabels.label: Calls Pokemon to make the new Pokemon of the draft
Calls list_pokemon to count the Pokemon the trainer has
Calls save_pokemon to store the new Pokemon in the party

children.label: Returns every Pokemon of the trainer
children.description: When a client sends `GET /api/v1/pokemon`, FastAPI [calls `current_trainer()` for the `CurrentTrainer` parameter](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/dependencies.py#L22), then calls this handler.

blockLabels.label: Returns every Pokemon of the trainer
Calls list_pokemon to read the Pokemon of the trainer

traceNodes.label: Shows, trains and releases one Pokemon
traceNodes.description: When a client sends `GET`, `PUT`, `PATCH` or `DELETE` to `/api/v1/pokemon/{pokemon_id}`, FastAPI matches the path below [the `/pokemon` prefix of the router](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L7), which [`main.py` includes under `/api/v1`](code:src/pokedex/main.py#L9). FastAPI then runs [`require_api_key()` from the dependencies of the router](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L7) and calls the handler of the method.

children.label: Returns the Pokemon of the id, or a 404
children.description: When a client sends `GET /api/v1/pokemon/{pokemon_id}`, FastAPI [reads `pokemon_id` from the path as an `int`](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L22) and calls this handler.

blockLabels.label: Calls find_pokemon to look up the Pokemon of the id
Raises an HTTPException when no Pokemon has the id

children.label: Replaces the name and the level of the Pokemon
children.description: When a client sends `PUT` or `PATCH` to `/api/v1/pokemon/{pokemon_id}`, FastAPI first runs [`log_change()` from the dependencies of the route](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L29). FastAPI then [parses the body into `PokemonDraft`](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L30), [calls `current_trainer()` for the `CurrentTrainer` parameter](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/dependencies.py#L22) and calls this handler.

blockLabels.label: Calls save_pokemon to store the new name and level
Calls Pokemon to make the Pokemon from the draft

children.label: Removes the Pokemon from the party
children.description: When a client sends `DELETE /api/v1/pokemon/{pokemon_id}`, FastAPI first runs [`log_change()` from the dependencies of the route](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L34). FastAPI then calls this handler and [answers with a 204](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L34).

blockLabels.label: Calls remove_pokemon to take the Pokemon out of the party

traceNodes.label: Parses and checks the name and the level of the body
traceNodes.description:
Two paths reach this model.
- When a client sends `POST /api/v1/pokemon`, FastAPI [parses the body into this model](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L11) before it calls `catch_pokemon()`.
- When a client sends `PUT` or `PATCH` to `/api/v1/pokemon/{pokemon_id}`, FastAPI [parses the body into this model](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L30) before it calls `train_pokemon()`.

blockLabels.label: Checks that the name has 1 to 20 characters
Checks that the level is from 1 to 100

traceNodes.label: Logs each request that changes a Pokemon
traceNodes.description:
Two paths reach this dependency.
- When a client sends `PUT` or `PATCH` to `/api/v1/pokemon/{pokemon_id}`, FastAPI calls it before `train_pokemon()`, because [the route lists it in its `dependencies`](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L29).
- When a client sends `DELETE /api/v1/pokemon/{pokemon_id}`, FastAPI calls it before `release_pokemon()`, because [the route lists it in its `dependencies`](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L34).

traceNodes.label: Returns a 401 for a wrong API key
traceNodes.description: When a client sends any request to `/api/v1/pokemon` or `/api/v1/pokemon/{pokemon_id}`, FastAPI calls this dependency before the handler, because [the router lists it in its `dependencies`](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L7). FastAPI reads `x_api_key` from the `x-api-key` header of the request.

blockLabels.label: Raises an HTTPException when the API key is missing or wrong

traceNodes.label: Reads the trainer from the x-trainer header
traceNodes.description:
Three paths reach this dependency.
- When a client sends `POST /api/v1/pokemon`, FastAPI calls it for the `trainer` parameter of [`catch_pokemon()`](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L11).
- When a client sends `GET /api/v1/pokemon`, FastAPI calls it for the `trainer` parameter of [`read_party()`](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L17).
- When a client sends `PUT` or `PATCH` to `/api/v1/pokemon/{pokemon_id}`, FastAPI calls it for the `trainer` parameter of [`train_pokemon()`](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/routes.py#L30).

Each parameter is typed [`CurrentTrainer`](code:src/pokedex/pokemon/dependencies.py#L22), which names this function in `Depends()`.

blockLabels.label: Returns the trainer name trimmed and in lower case
